Settle whether wave 1 is F alone, and whether C's non-dependent preparatory work (naming observables before unit selection, the control-arm baseline) may run in parallel.

q5.imperative: Ask the human, with a recommendation. #423's hitl_reason makes every close and cluster boundary his explicit confirm, and the spec makes wave/cluster boundaries costly-to-revert. Settle how the re-cut runs (Admiral + human at the keyboard, or a dispatched flow with batched confirms), and how the 149 open issues — 43 of them unlabelled — get handled.

q6.title: DECISION: budget, model tiers, permission pre-clearances, and contract expiry
q6.imperative: Ask the human, with a recommendation. Carry the #145 lesson: an eval/measurement mission must pre-clear its own core mechanics at contract time. F and C are both measurement missions (tracer dispatches, corpus surgery, MCP server processes, .mcp.json writes). Settle the tier table, the pre-clearance rows, and the expiry.

q7.title: DECISION: F's pre-build branch point — who runs the .mcp.json pickup probe, and what happens on each branch?
q7.imperative: Ask the human, with a recommendation. The spec records a pre-build branch point: does an interactive session pick up a fresh .mcp.json without a restart? Picked up means project-scope .mcp.json suffices; not picked up means per-dispatch config generation is the delivery path and gets designed first. Settle whether the Commander probes and proceeds on its own answer, or the branch comes back to the human.

Run python3 /home/tommy/.claude/skills/constellation-interrogator/scripts/verify_interrogation.py on the record — it MUST exit 0. Record pass only after exit 0, then consolidate.

postconditions.statement: verify_interrogation.py exits 0 on the interrogation record -- refuses a self-answered decision or a consolidation with no joint-understanding sign-off
